outputs.notes: Resolved prod host CONFIRMED as dpg-d85140f7f7vs73fvdqhg-a.oregon-postgres.render.com (matched exactly against npm run db:status:prod output header) before migrating. Invariant checks: BEFORE db:generate, npm run db:status:prod showed repo journal 36 / prod applied 36 / pending 0 (up to date, matching the plan's note that this session already applied through 0035). AFTER db:generate, exactly one new migration was produced: 0036_tense_secret_warriors.sql (curriculum text nullable, chapter text nullable, has_homework boolean not-null default false, has_assessment boolean not-null default false — all additive ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN on lesson_tasks, no backfill, no composite-FK ordering issue). Re-ran db:status:prod immediately before migrating to reconfirm 0036 was the only pending entry. AFTER db:migrate:prod, db:status:prod showed repo journal 37 / prod applied 37 / pending 0 — no gap — and lesson_tasks row count unchanged at 776 (no data loss), all 31 schema tables still reachable. Final field names chosen exactly as the plan suggested: curriculum?: string, chapter?: string, hasHomework?: boolean, hasAssessment?: boolean on LessonTask — no collision with this branch's existing scheduledStartTime/scheduledEndTime (G7a) fields; confirmed by reading db/schema.ts and features/plan/types.ts before finalizing. Card precedence decided per the plan's anatomy diagram (which shows only chapter, not title, once chapter is set): when lesson.chapter is set, chapter renders as the card's focal line and curriculum (if set) as a muted sub-line directly beneath it; the original title is NOT duplicated alongside chapter. When chapter is unset, the card falls back to title as the focal line (P2/P3 behavior unchanged). hasHomework/hasAssessment render as 📝/📋 spans (data-testid=homework-indicator/assessment-indicator) only when true — presence-only, confirmed by a dedicated test (card001 with neither flag renders neither indicator). All P4 card work landed inline in WeeklyPlanner.tsx's existing data-lesson-card block (per P3's handoff note — PlannerLessonCard.tsx was never extracted); a data-testid=lesson-card-<id> attribute was added alongside the existing data-lesson-card boolean attribute so tests could target a specific card by id now that title text is no longer always present on the card (needed because several pre-existing P2/P3 tests located lesson_003's card via screen.getByText('Chapter 91'), which broke once chapter='Ch. 91' replaced title as the focal text — those tests were updated to use the new testid, not the card behavior). API routes (lesson.ts PUT, lessons.ts POST) and repository.ts (create/update/fan-out) wire the four new fields through exactly the same optional-field pattern already used for scheduledStartTime/scheduledEndTime ('field' in body ? ... : undefined for PUT, ?? undefined/null for POST/create). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the repository.test.ts itDb round-trip/omit tests for the new fields were written (TDD) but were NOT executed against a live DB in this run — the non-prod .env.local DATABASE_URL (a different host, dpg-d8jegg3bc2fs73bkhqm0-a.virginia-postgres.render.com) timed out/was unreachable when actually attempted (confirmed via a direct npx dotenv -e .env.local -- jest run against features/plan/__tests__/api/repository.test.ts, which failed all 13 itDb cases in that file on a 30s beforeAll timeout, not just the 2 new ones — this is a pre-existing DB-reachability problem, not something introduced by this phase). Running those CRUD round-trip tests against PRODUCTION instead was deliberately avoided since the user's authorization covered only the schema migration, not exploratory insert/delete traffic against prod's lesson_tasks table (776 real rows). The itDb tests will run automatically once a reachable non-prod DATABASE_URL exists; until then they skip cleanly (hasDb=false) inside plain npm test, which is what doneWhen actually requires. Whoever next needs a working non-prod Postgres target should treat this as an open infra gap, not assume the current .env.local DATABASE_URL is live.
